custodianAssessment.localOrScopedEvidence: The official Jincheng Town service site places the town in Changzhou, Jintan District and identifies its local service center. The official Jintan District Natural Resources and Planning Bureau description assigns unified real-estate registration, cadastral surveying, rights investigation, and results application responsibilities to that bureau. This establishes a local/scoped custodian, not successful parcel-layer retrieval.
